title: Console feature launch: sprint sync, persona-guided release notes, and enablement scripts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate cross-functional go-to-market for three Console UX features: expanded per-route dashboards, rollout orchestration UI, and token-level cost breakdowns. This ticket covers release notes segmentation for different personas (SE, Dev, Finance), internal enablement (SE playbook, CS training, quick-start scripts), and a sprint-level sync cadence to reduce last-minute blockers. Outcome: shipping with documented runbooks, persona-specific release notes, one internal brown-bag, and a public release notes page plus email/announce assets.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted with persona sections (Developer, Platform, Finance) and approved by Legal and Compliance
Enablement assets created: SE playbook, CS FAQ, 15-min demo deck, and two scripted troubleshooting KBs
Launch runbook validated with Eng on rollback steps and fallback model variants
Support rotations scheduled and trained: 2 SEs for first 48 hours, 4 CS staff for 7-day coverage
Customer-facing release notes published and announced via product newsletter and in-app banner
launch_steps: Week -3: Finalize UI copy and screenshots with Design (DES-224). Pull latest screenshots from staging-23 and approve
Week -2: Draft persona release notes and create short 'what changed' bullets for SDK docs
Week -2: Create enablement playbook for SEs (runbook + troubleshooting scripts). Link to GH runbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-runbooks/pull/128
Week -1: Internal brown-bag with Product/Eng/Design and recorded Q&A (recording -> Drive)
Launch day: Publish notes, enable in-app banner, trigger newsletter, monitor telemetry and SLO dashboards
Post-launch +1w: Collect top 10 customer-reported issues and open immediate follow-up tickets
Post-launch +3w: Run calibration session to review quality metrics and cost regressions
